collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: At the end of the day, a villager sweeps the doorway and looks out at the village.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: At the end of the day, (name1) sweeps the doorway and looks out at the village. Smoke rises from several cooking fires, and the air smells of supper.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: At the end of the day, (name1) sweeps the doorway and looks out at the village. A neighbor waves, and (name1) waves back.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: At the end of the day, (name1) sweeps the doorway and looks out at the village. The first stars appear, and (name1) decides the sweeping can wait a moment.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: At the end of the day, (name1) sweeps the doorway and looks out at the village. (name1) leans on the broom and feels that today was a good day.
